Local live run against REB, 2026-11-12 15:44-16:03 PST, from the crossbill worktree, same identity and command shape as the jira-cloud-mutation-probe job (--timeout=1800 --timeout-method=thread): 2 passed in 1128 s (round-trip test 713 s, missing-version test 412 s). Afterwards REB version search ?query=cloudprobe- returned no versions and no cloudprobe issues remained.
An earlier local attempt (15:37 PST) ran without --timeout=1800 and hit pytest's 300 s default, which kills the process before finally runs. It left REB-7145 and 3 cloudprobe-local-336df8f2b4a9 versions; the new prefix backstops (sweep_prefixed_issues, sweep_versions) removed all 4, confirmed by a 404 on REB-7145 and an empty version search. That is the case the summary-prefix sweep exists for.
Commit 305bf97267b; make verify running. The [non-codebase] AC still needs the CI jira-cloud-mutation-probe run after merge.
